events.text: Schultze joined the Bundesmarine of West Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 2 July 1956 , Schultze joined the Bundesmarine of West Germany

events.text: Schultze's first disposition was commander of the 3rd Ship Home Department.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His first disposition was commander of the 3rd Ship Home Department . He served in this capacity from 2 July 1956

events.text: Schultze's service as commander of the 3rd Ship Home Department ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served in this capacity from 2 July 1956 to 15 February 1959

events.text: Schultze retired with the rank of Kapitän zur See.
